description: Plan the next steps for connecting a repository, reviewing an evaluation, or ingesting traces. Use it when deciding what to set up next. Returns an ordered advisory step list and a web link; it never runs, writes or accepts anything.

target.description: Workflow to plan: local repository setup, hosted evaluation review, or trace ingestion. Defaults to repository; never executes the plan.

name: project_plan

deepLink.description: EvalGate web path or absolute URL for inspecting these results.
